# Appendix: Reference 6400 MT/s USB/FDL Training Envelope (`G3`)

## Capture metadata

- **Series / Condition**: **`G3`** (External heater), USB/FDL staging (`fastboot stage` + `fastboot continue`), `6400 MT/s`, `SequenceCtrl = 0x125f`, training duration **`5,628 ms`**
- **RX ODT setting**: `CSR[0x010048/4a/4c/4d] = 0x0c00` (`60 Ω` default)
- **`DDR0` (`PMU0`)**: `3874`/`5170` nonzero `phypara`, `1845`/`4096` nonzero `ACSM`, `CSR[0x020011] = 0x006f`, `CSR[0x0c0086] = 0x0001`, `CSR[0x030001] = 0x0004`, `0x4e`/`0x4f` median **`62.5`** taps (`mean 62.32`, range `45`–`74`), `CSR[0x02000a]/[0x020017]/[0x020187] = 133/67/67`, `CSR[0x01<r>0af] = 0x003e, 0x003f, 0x003d, 0x003e`, `TrainedVREFCA_A0 = 0x3f`, `TrainedVREFDQ_A0 = 0x28`, `RxClkDly_Margin_A0 = 0x16`
- **`DDR1` (`PMU1`)**: `3875`/`5170` nonzero `phypara`, `1845`/`4096` nonzero `ACSM`, `CSR[0x020011] = 0x006f`, `CSR[0x0c0086] = 0x0001`, `CSR[0x030001] = 0x0000`, `0x4e`/`0x4f` median **`62.0`** taps (`mean 61.82`, range `49`–`75`), `CSR[0x02000a]/[0x020017]/[0x020187] = 133/67/68`, `CSR[0x01<r>0af] = 0x003b, 0x003d, 0x003b, 0x003b`, `TrainedVREFCA_A0 = 0x3f`, `TrainedVREFDQ_A0 = 0x26`, `RxClkDly_Margin_A0 = 0x15`
- **Tail (`0x93c8..0x97ff`)**: All `1,080` bytes are `0x00`; appending `1,080` zero bytes after Controller 1 ACSM reconstructs the exact `0x9800`-byte `DDRT` binary whose `zlib.crc32(buf[0x08:0x9800])` is **`0x16ddbe38`**.

## Envelope header (`0x0000..0x007f`, 128 bytes)

- `magic` (`0x00`): `0x54524444` (`"DDRT"`)
- `crc32` (`0x04`): `0x16ddbe38` (`zlib.crc32(buf[0x08:0x9800])`)
- `chipid` (`0x08`): `0x2000000000000000`
- `mac_addr` (`0x10`): `0x0000000000000000`
- `version` (`0x18`): `0`
- `type` (`0x1c`): `0` (LPDDR5)
- `cs_num` (`0x20`): `0`
- `data_rate` (`0x24`): `1`
